observation_summary: Write a report on optimal token use for recursive self-improvement across the full Emily OS system. Analyse current token spend per cycle in emily-agent (cron.go RSI loop), observation-watcher invocations, and prime-task → Claude Code dispatches. Identify the highest-ROI improvements: e.g. prompt compression, caching, batching observations, gating trivial cycles. Produce a prioritised action list with estimated token savings per item. Then implement the top item as a concrete code change, commit it, and post findings as an IDUNA Apple.
actions_taken: Performed fourth-cycle RSI token efficiency analysis. Read emily-agent/main.go (FatBaby tool loop), cmd/observation-watcher/main.go, EMILY/emily-agent/cron.go (Emily Prime RSI cycle), EMILY/emily-agent/rsi.go (iteration engine), and EMILY/scripts/rsi-loop.sh to map token spend across all three subsystems. Reviewed previous three cycles' claude-run reports to avoid duplicating implemented work. Identified that the FatBaby runToolLoop already caches system+tools (~5,400T) from 7b7d688 but does NOT cache the growing conversation history (tool calls + results from previous turns). Added cache_control: {type: ephemeral} to the last tool-result block of each turn in runToolLoop. This means on turn N+1, the API caches the prefix through turn N, so only the new turn's content (~400-800T) is fresh input instead of the full accumulated history (~1,500-4,500T for turns 3-10). Tests pass. Committed d84b500 and pushed.
notes: Four-cycle summary: Cycle 1 (7b7d688) = system+tools caching; Cycle 2 (EMILY 57cfb90) = EMILY RSI prompt caching + cr.Value truncation; Cycle 3 (71e73b0) = extractLessons optimisation + batch-window 60s + symlink fix; Cycle 4 (d84b500) = conversation history caching in runToolLoop. Remaining highest-ROI items: (1) prime-task batching — N queued tasks in one claude invocation saves N-1 invocation overheads; (2) entity-graph rules inline skip when hash unchanged (~320T/dispatch). Token savings estimate for this cycle: 2,000-4,500T per 5-10 turn tick, compounding across all tick invocations. IDUNA Apple post attempted below.
